title: ENHANCING GROUP FAIRNESS IN ONLINE SETTINGS USING OBLIQUE DECISION FORESTS
findings: The proposed method, Aranyani, achieved a significantly better accuracy-fairness trade-off on the CivilComments dataset compared to baseline systems. It was more effective at maintaining high accuracy in toxicity classification while reducing the disparity in predictions for comments associated with different religious groups (Muslims and Christians).

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the demographic parity (a group fairness metric) in an online toxicity classification task, using religion as the protected attribute. Specifically, it evaluated the discrepancy in toxicity predictions for comments associated with 'Muslim' and 'Christian' labels.
